reports.note: *** 1 INJ *** Approximate start point of an EF-1 rated tornado that moved north through the Heber-Overgaard area. Peak winds estimated to be 110 mph along its 11 minute journey. The path was just over 9 miles with maximum width estimated to be around 350 yards. There was 1 non life-threatening injury reported.

A tornado developed in the Via Caballero neighborhood in the south central portion of Santa Fe just north of I-25. The tornado traveled northward for approximately 1.4 miles, terminating near the College of Santa Fe. Much of the damage was along Rancho Siringo and Camino Chueco Roads. Damage included broken power poles, uprooted or damaged trees, damage to roofs. Ten homes sustained damaged. This tornado has been given a preliminary rating of EF-1, pending additional information.

An EF1 rated tornado developed south of Walker and traveled north-northeast across Walker Road. The estimated maximum wind speed was 105 mph along its 8 mile path. Maximum width was estimated to be 300 yards.
